concepts.name: Circle and Its Elements
concepts.description: A circle is the set of all points in a plane that are at a fixed distance from a fixed point called the center. Its important elements include the radius, diameter, chord, arc, tangent, and secant.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to identify the fundamental parts of a circle and describe their properties.

concepts.name: Tangents to a Circle
concepts.description: A tangent is a line that touches a circle at exactly one point without intersecting its interior. It plays a significant role in understanding circle geometry.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to distinguish between tangents, secants, and chords of a circle.

concepts.name: Perpendicularity of Radius and Tangent
concepts.description: The radius drawn to the point of contact of a tangent is always perpendicular to the tangent. This theorem is fundamental in solving geometrical problems involving circles.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to prove and apply the theorem that the radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of contact.

concepts.name: Uniqueness of Tangent
concepts.description: Exactly one tangent can be drawn to a circle at any given point on its circumference. This property helps establish several geometric proofs.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to explain why only one tangent exists at a given point on a circle.

concepts.name: Applications of Tangent Properties
concepts.description: Properties of tangents are applied to determine unknown angles, lengths, and relationships in geometric constructions.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to solve geometry problems involving tangents and radii.

topics.title: Number of Tangents from a Point on a Circle

concepts.name: Tangents from External, Internal, and Circumference Points
concepts.description: The number of tangents that can be drawn depends on the position of the point relative to the circle: two from an external point, one from a point on the circle, and none from an interior point.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to determine the number of tangents that can be drawn from different positions relative to a circle.

concepts.name: Equal Tangent Segments
concepts.description: The lengths of the two tangent segments drawn from the same external point to a circle are always equal.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to prove and apply the theorem that tangent segments from an external point are equal.

concepts.name: Applications of Equal Tangents
concepts.description: Equal tangent properties are widely used in proving geometric theorems and finding unknown lengths in circle-based constructions.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to solve geometric problems involving tangent lengths and circle properties.

concepts.name: Key Concepts of Circles
concepts.description: This chapter summarizes the properties of tangents, the relationship between radii and tangents, and the characteristics of tangent segments drawn from external points.
concepts.learning_outcome: Students will be able to apply the fundamental theorems of tangents to solve geometric proofs and numerical problems involving circles.
